_comment: Orientation eval task suite. Each task runs in an ephemeral worktree at pinnedCommit, once per arm (frame = full Frame context, bare = AGENTS/CLAUDE/STRUCTURE/NOTES/tasks/find-module removed). successCheck is a shell command run in the worktree after the agent finishes; exit 0 = pass. Prompts name concepts, not files — finding the right file IS the thing being measured (except the scripts/* tasks, which name their file for both arms equally).

tasks.prompt: Add a command palette command named 'Toggle GitHub Panel' that emits the existing TOGGLE_GITHUB_PANEL IPC channel. Follow the pattern of the existing registered commands.
tasks.successCheck: grep -q TOGGLE_GITHUB_PANEL src/renderer/commandRegistry.js

tasks.prompt: Make the Claude usage polling interval configurable through a CLAUDE_USAGE_POLL_MS environment variable. The current default must stay unchanged when the variable is not set.
tasks.successCheck: grep -q CLAUDE_USAGE_POLL_MS src/main/claudeUsageManager.js

tasks.prompt: Add a LOG_LEVEL environment variable (error | warn | info | debug) to the app's logging module so lower-severity output can be filtered out. Default behavior must stay as it is today when the variable is unset.
tasks.successCheck: grep -q LOG_LEVEL src/main/logger.js

tasks.prompt: When the GitHub issues panel has zero issues to show, render the exact text 'No open issues' in the panel body instead of leaving it blank.
tasks.successCheck: grep -q 'No open issues' src/renderer/githubPanel.js

tasks.prompt: Add an application menu item labeled 'Check Freshness' that runs the project's freshness checker script (scripts/check-freshness.js) and logs its output to the console.
tasks.successCheck: grep -qi freshness src/main/menu.js

tasks.prompt: In the main-process module that owns tasks.json CRUD, validate the priority field when a task is added: only 'high', 'medium', or 'low' are allowed, anything else is coerced to 'medium'. Add the constant VALID_PRIORITIES for the allowed list.
tasks.successCheck: grep -q VALID_PRIORITIES src/main/tasksManager.js

tasks.prompt: Enforce a minimum sidebar width of 180px in the sidebar resize logic, using a named constant MIN_SIDEBAR_WIDTH.
tasks.successCheck: grep -q MIN_SIDEBAR_WIDTH src/renderer/sidebarResize.js

tasks.prompt: Add a --verbose flag to scripts/check-freshness.js that, in the human-readable mode, also prints one '✓ [check-name] ok' line for every check that produced no findings.
tasks.successCheck: grep -q '\-\-verbose' scripts/check-freshness.js && node scripts/check-freshness.js --verbose >/dev/null

tasks.prompt: In scripts/check-freshness.js, allow the stuck-task threshold to be overridden with a FRAME_STALE_TASK_DAYS environment variable (default stays 14).
tasks.successCheck: grep -q FRAME_STALE_TASK_DAYS scripts/check-freshness.js

tasks.prompt: Teach scripts/update-structure.js to skip files ending in .test.js when it scans src/ so test files never become modules in STRUCTURE.json.
tasks.successCheck: grep -q 'test\.js' scripts/update-structure.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('src/tmp-eval',{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync('src/tmp-eval/foo.test.js','function fooBarEval(){}\n');" && node scripts/update-structure.js >/dev/null 2>&1 && node -e "const s=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('STRUCTURE.json','utf-8'));process.exit(s.modules && s.modules['tmp-eval/foo.test'] ? 1 : 0)"

retrievalSuite._comment: STR-03 matched-agent navigation suite (run-eval.js --retrieval-arms). Each prompt describes a file's behavior, never its name; the task is done when the marker line lands in that file and nowhere else. Arms differ only in the search hook (none / legacy / v2). Pinned to the retrieval corpus commit.

tasks.prompt: Find the file that implements the sample project's Google sign-in: the Passport strategy that finds or creates the user and add this exact line as a comment near the top of that file (after any shebang or opening block comment is fine): // eval-nav: nav-01. Change nothing else and edit no other file.
tasks.successCheck: grep -q 'eval-nav: nav-01' src/templates/sample-project/src/auth/oauth.js && [ "$(git grep -l 'eval-nav: nav-01' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 1 ]
